name: io.github.vobiz-ai/vobiz-mcp
title: Vobiz
description: Vobiz voice calls, IVRs, call records, numbers, SIP trunks, SMS/MMS/RCS and Vobiz skills.

environmentVariables.name: VOBIZ_AUTH_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your Vobiz Auth ID (MA_... or SA_...) from the console overview page.

environmentVariables.name: VOBIZ_ENABLE_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow placing outbound calls (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: VOBIZ_ENABLE_MESSAGING
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow sending SMS/MMS/RCS and changing opt-outs (off by default).

environmentVariables.name: VOBIZ_ENABLE_PROVISIONING
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow buying numbers and changing trunks and applications (off by default).
